text: This report provides an update on the progress in the establishment of the fundraising entity and requests the support of the Board of Management to facilitate the next steps.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the amount of up to $500,000 to be made available, if required, from funds held by the Toronto Foundation, for the purposes of establishing the new Toronto Zoo Wildlife Conservancy to be transferred at the discretion of the Manager of Financial Services. 2. Appointed the Chair of the Board of Management and the Chief Executive Officer of the Toronto Zoo as permanent appointees to the Toronto Zoo Wildlife Conservancy Board of Directors.
